title: Sky Scene 8 — Flying in Different Directions
purpose: Direction words, movement descriptions and multi-clue identification.

sentenceModels: The balloon is floating above the lake.
The helicopter is flying on the right.
The airplane is below the helicopter.
The eagle is gliding near the balloon.

adultSupport.focus: Ask where each flying subject is and combine location with movement.
starterPrompts: What is flying on the right?
expansionPrompts: First point to the balloon, then point to the airplane.
Find the animal that is flying near the balloon.

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 2 automatic pass against the visible teaching targets.
